title: fix(plugin-form): each form section draws its own columns count per row (objectui#12548)
body:
Fixes #12548
Clause-②: no — no type, prop, export or spec declaration changes; `sectionedGridLayout` / `TWELVE_TRACK_GRID_COLS` live in `autoLayout.ts` and are not re-exported from the package entry.

## What changed

A sectioned form draws all its sections in ONE field grid, sized by the widest section, and each field spanned `Math.round(grid / sectionColumns)` cells of it. When a section's count did not fit that grid, the section drew the wrong number of fields per row. Measured on `main` at `9c2785b`, ModalForm, 2 / 3 / 1 form:

| field | grid | cell |
|---|---|---|
| `columns: 2` field | `grid-cols-1 @md:grid-cols-2 @2xl:grid-cols-3` | `@md:col-span-2` → **one per row at every tier** |
| `columns: 3` field | same | (none) → 2 / 3 per row (correct) |
| `columns: 1` field, `span: 'full'` | same | `@md:col-span-2 @2xl:col-span-3` (correct) |
| `columns: 3` beside `columns: 4` | `… @4xl:grid-cols-4` | (none) → **four per row at `@4xl`** |

ObjectForm, SplitForm, TabbedForm and WizardForm (under a form-level `columns: 3`) drew the same classes.

**One shared rule**, `sectionedGridLayout(formColumns, sectionColumns[])` in `packages/plugin-form/src/autoLayout.ts`, now called by all five hosts in place of the per-host `applyAutoColSpan` + `containerGridColsFor` pair:

- **Every section is 1 or the grid width:** the rule returns the old `CONTAINER_GRID_COLS` grid and the old `applyAutoColSpan` spans. Single-density forms, and forms with no section `columns`, are therefore byte-identical.
- **Otherwise:** the grid is `grid gap-4 grid-cols-1 @md:grid-cols-12`, and each field's `colSpan` counts twelfths of the row:
  - `span: 'full'` and wide widgets take 12;
  - an authored `colSpan` counts that many of its own section's columns, clamped to them;
  - any other field takes 12 / the section's columns.
  - A section's count is still clamped to the form grid, so a form-level `columns` still outranks it.

**`@object-ui/components` form renderer** (where the span classes are drawn): on a container carrying `@md:grid-cols-12`, a twelfths `colSpan` maps through a literal table, `TWELVE_TRACK_SPAN_CLASS`. The table keeps each count's existing step ladder:

| section `columns` | twelfths | classes | per row at `@md` / `@2xl` / `@4xl` |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 12 | `@md:col-span-12` | 1 / 1 / 1 |
| 2 | 6 | `@md:col-span-6` | 2 / 2 / 2 |
| 3 | 4 | `@md:col-span-6 @2xl:col-span-4` | 2 / 3 / 3 |
| 4 | 3 | `@md:col-span-6 @2xl:col-span-4 @4xl:col-span-3` | 2 / 3 / 4 |
| authored 2 of 3 | 8 | `@md:col-span-12 @2xl:col-span-8` | |
| authored 3 of 4 | 9 | `@md:col-span-12 @4xl:col-span-9` | |

Below `@md` the form stays one column. Every other container is rendered by the old code path, unchanged. The literal `'@md:grid-cols-12'` sits in components' source, so the published `style.css` carries the utility too.

## Verification record (at `88bfef0`)

- New pins, `plugin-form/src/__tests__/mixedSectionColumns-12548.test.tsx` (25 tests):
  - per host (modal / object / split / tabbed, plus wizard under a form-level `columns: 3`), a 2 / 3 / 1 form reads 2 / 3 / 1 per row at `@4xl` and 2 / 2 / 1 at `@md`, and the 3-column section reads 3 at `@2xl`;
  - `span: 'full'` takes the row; base `grid-cols-1`; 3-beside-4 reads three per row;
  - CONTROL: all `columns: 2` and all `columns: 3`, per host, keep the literal grid and span classes `main` drew;
  - a drift guard: each count's ladder on the 12-track grid equals `min(columns, tier)` against `CONTAINER_GRID_COLS[4]`'s tiers;
  - pure-rule pins.
- Renderer pins, `components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/form-twelve-track-span-12548.test.tsx` (7), including a CONTROL that the 1–4 containers emit as before.
- Before the fix, the new file ran 6 failed / 8 passed on `main`: the mixed pins red, the CONTROLs green.
- Ablation 1: `sectionedGridLayout` forced to the old path. 12 mixed pins red, 13 green (all 8 CONTROLs among them). Restore was proven by blob hash and an empty `git diff HEAD`.
- Ablation 2: the renderer's 12-track detection turned off. 16 red, 16 green, restored the same way.
- `pnpm --filter '@object-ui/plugin-form^...' build` → 0
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/plugin-form type-check` → 0
- `pnpm --filter @object-ui/components type-check` → 0
- tsc over both new test files → 0 (the package type-checks exclude tests)
- Whole `packages/plugin-form` suite: 184 files, 2269 passed, 1 skipped → 0
- Every suite that renders a host or touches the census, plus `components/src/renderers/form/__tests__/*`: 225 files → 0
  - packages: 208 files, 3067 passed, 17 skipped
  - apps / examples / scripts: 17 files, 1465 passed
- `check:control-bytes`, `check:new-line-citations` (0 new), `check-changeset-presence`, `check-changeset-no-major`, `check:changeset-claims`, `check:pending-changeset-literals`, `check:test-path-roots`, `check:vi-mock-specifiers`, `check:vi-mock-inherit`, `check:vi-mock-override-shape`, `check:unreferenced-sources`, eslint on the 9 changed files (0 errors) → all 0
- Tailwind v4 compile of `apps/console/src/index.css` emits `@md:grid-cols-12`, `@md:col-span-{6,12}`, `@2xl:col-span-{4,8}` and `@4xl:col-span-{3,9}`; `@md:col-span-8` and `@2xl:col-span-12` are absent, as expected. Compiling `packages/components/src/index.css` also emits `@md:grid-cols-12`.
- NOT MEASURED locally: `check:readme-exports` (needs every package's dist; no export changed) and `performance-budget` (a full console build). Both are left to CI.

## What the landing seat's browser reading should show

HotCRM Leads → New. Pre-merge reading: the HotCRM-shaped DOM rendered by `ModalForm`, measured in Chromium with the console's Tailwind build:

| dialog | Contact Information (2) | `last_name` (`span: 'full'`) | Lead Classification (3) | Company (2) | Additional (1) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1368px, before | **1 per row, 875px** | 1320px | 3 per row, 429px | 1 per row, 875px | 1320px |
| 1368px, after | **2 per row, 652px each** | 1320px | 3 per row, 429px (unchanged) | 2 per row, 652px | 1320px |
| 1024px, after | 2 per row, 480px | 976px | 3 per row, 315px (unchanged) | 2 per row, 480px | 976px |
| 640px, after | 2 per row, 288px | 592px | 2 per row, 288px (unchanged ladder) | 2 per row | 592px |
| 400px, after | 1 per row | 1 per row | 1 per row | 1 per row | 1 per row |

At 1440 the seat should see:
- Contact Information at two fields per row, of one width;
- `last_name` on its own full row;
- Lead Classification at three per row;
- nothing empty in the right third except a row's natural remainder.

## Acceptance notes

- The dialog's size (`inferModalSize`, `modalSize`, `AppContent.tsx`) and the no-section-`columns` default are untouched. objectui#12521 and PR #12546 keep them. #12546 touches `ModalForm.tsx` and `autoLayout.ts` in different regions, so expect a merge of `main` in its rework round.
- In a mixed form an authored `colSpan` counts its SECTION's columns (2 in a 3-column section = two thirds of the row). Before, it counted cells of the widest section's grid. A single-density form keeps the old reading.
- Authored `colSpan: 2` in a `columns: 4` section of a mixed form reduces to one half and reads half the row at every tier. On a 4-only grid it reads full / two thirds / half.
- A section `gridClassName` in a tabbed or split form with mixed densities sits beside twelfths spans. That combination was already inconsistent before this change.
- objectui has no `scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs`, so the gate list was derived by hand from `package.json` `check:*` and the workflows.
